lines.en: Heavy steps creak.
Mail clanks together.
Metal boots on stone.
Moves slowly, like a ghost.
Green pupils stare ahead.
Muttering spells, voice hoarse.

lines.zh: 挥舞长矛，发出金属碰撞声。
lines.en: Wields spear, metal clangs.

lines.zh: 我拖着斧子走过碎石地。
lines.en: I drag my axe across the gravel.
Green light from armor gaps.

lines.zh: 摸索石壁，寻找藏身之处。
lines.en: Scans walls for hiding spots.

lines.zh: 单手提矛，拖着步子行走。
lines.en: Spear in one hand, it drags its steps along.

lines.zh: 绿皮从盔甲缝里透出来。
lines.en: Green skin shows through the gaps in its armor.
leans against the wall, deep in thought.
stares into the abyss, eyes hollow.
taps spear, echoing sound.
occasionally looks around.
licks claws, sharp and deadly.
eats shriveled goblin fruit.
stands silently in the shadows.
raises spear, ready for anything.
eyes flicker, wary of surroundings.
Half-asleep eyes, blade still up.
It draws circles on the stone with its spear tip.
It dozes off, green eyes half shut.
It stuffs groglin fruit into its mouth.
It runs a thumb over the notches on its spear.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，呼吸急促。
lines.en: locks eyes on the player, breathes heavily.
pupils dilate, greedy.
creeps closer, step by step.

lines.zh: 长矛指向玩家，蓄势待发。
lines.en: spear points at the player, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 突然转身，消失在阴影中。
lines.en: turns suddenly, vanishes in the shadows.
growls low, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 用长矛指指玩家，示意攻击。
lines.en: points spear at the player, signals attack.
eyes glow, locking on the prey.
creeps close, planning ambush.
hisses, threatening the player.

lines.zh: 它用矛尖点了点你的方向。
lines.en: It points its spear tip your way.
Its green face leans in to smell you.

lines.zh: 它把矛横过来，挡住去路。
lines.en: It turns its spear crosswise to block the way.
Its dull eyes suddenly sharpen.
It licks its lips and stares at you.
The muttering stops; it starts watching you.
The spear tip halts just before you.

lines.zh: 它退半步，又往前挪半步。
lines.en: It backs half a step, then creeps forward again.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出黑绿色的粘液。
lines.en: Black-green slime oozes from the wound.
Weak gasps of agony.

lines.zh: 我感到一阵寒意，虚弱不堪。
lines.en: A chill runs through me, weakening me.
Tormented by immense pain.
Each step is drenched in blood.

lines.zh: 痛苦如同刀割，无法忍受。
lines.en: Pain like a knife, unbearable.

lines.zh: 伤口让我的力量迅速流失。
lines.en: Wounds drain my strength quickly.
So weak, barely standing.

lines.zh: 每一口气都显得如此沉重。
lines.en: Each breath feels so heavy.

lines.zh: 绿血从盔甲的缝隙里涌出。
lines.en: Green blood wells out through the gaps in its armor.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的肉块，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It stares at your meat block, hissing.
It roars as you approach.

lines.zh: 它伸出触手，试图抓住你。
lines.en: Its tentacles reach out to grab you.
Its voice is full of greed.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的那块肉。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on the meat in your hand.
That meat is mine. Don't grab it.
Its skin is covered in slime.
It tries to wrap its tentacles around you.
Its eyes are only on the prey.

lines.zh: 它的叫声回荡在洞穴中。
lines.en: Its call echoes through the cave.

lines.zh: 它突然从阴影中出现，挡住了你的去路。
lines.en: It suddenly appears from the shadows, blocking your path.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞上了你的盔甲。
lines.en: Its body crashes into your armor.

lines.zh: 你们撞到了一起，它露出獠牙。
lines.en: You collide, and it shows its fangs.
You bump into its hard shell.
It tries to trip you with its tentacles.
Its body blocks your way.
You bump into its tentacles.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠住了你的腿。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your leg.
You collide with its body.

lines.zh: 它的身体阻挡了你的前进。
lines.en: Its body blocks your advance.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶声，吸引你的注意。
lines.en: It makes a mating call to attract you.
It shows you its mark.
It gently touches you with its tentacles.
It tries to mate with you.

lines.zh: 我在你身边绕圈，找破绽。
lines.en: I circle you, looking for an opening.
It hisses a mating call.

lines.zh: 它用触手抚摸你的身体。
lines.en: It strokes your body with its tentacles.
It waits nearby for a chance.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中充满了渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes are filled with desire.
It tries to grab you with its tentacles.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精战士的盔甲发出微光。
lines.en: Groglin Warrior's armor glows faintly.

lines.zh: 捡起它的碎片，你会感受到寒意。
lines.en: The shards give off a chilling sensation.

lines.zh: 小心，盔甲中有暗藏的秘密。
lines.en: Be cautious, the armor holds secrets.

lines.zh: 盔甲中似乎藏有地精的符文。
lines.en: Runic symbols seem etched into the armor.

lines.zh: 地精的盔甲中蕴含着力量。
lines.en: Power radiates from the groglin's armor.

lines.zh: 它的盔甲比看起来更重。
lines.en: The armor is heavier than it appears.

lines.zh: 盔甲散发出诡异的光芒。
lines.en: An eerie light emanates from the armor.
Blood stains are still wet on the armor.

lines.zh: 盔甲中似乎还有其他东西。
lines.en: There's something else in the armor.

lines.zh: 你突然感到盔甲的重量。
lines.en: You suddenly feel the weight of the armor.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着红色光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with a red light.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同地底的低吟。
lines.en: Its voice is a low rumble from below.
Its eyes lock onto you.

lines.zh: 地精的低语在黑暗中回荡。
lines.en: The groglin's whisper echoes in the dark.
You feel it watching you in the dark.

lines.zh: 地精的低语在耳边响起。
lines.en: The groglin whispers in your ear.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同地下沼泽的回响。
lines.en: Its voice echoes from the underground marshes.

lines.zh: 它的目光犹如幽暗的火焰。
lines.en: Its gaze is like a dark flame.

lines.zh: 地精的低语在你脑海中回响。
lines.en: The groglin's whispers resound in your mind.
It seems to be waiting for something.

lines.zh: 它数清了你有几件好东西。
lines.en: It has counted the good things you carry.

lines.zh: 矛锋抬起，对准你的喉咙。
lines.en: The spear lifts and points at your throat.

lines.zh: 洞里的回音停在它耳畔。
lines.en: The cave echo stops at its ear.

lines.zh: 它的影子贴着石壁摸过来。
lines.en: Its shadow slides along the stone wall toward you.

lines.zh: 它把你当成了今天的猎物。
lines.en: It marks you as today's quarry.

lines.zh: 咕哝声变成了短促的号令。
lines.en: Its mumbling turns into a sharp command.
Its weapon glows with cold.
The groglin's weapon points at you.
The weapon's chill makes you shiver.
It prepares to attack you with its weapon.

lines.zh: 武器上附有地精的魔法。
lines.en: Magic from the groglin's weapon.
Chill radiates from the weapon.

lines.zh: 武器上覆盖着地精的符文。
lines.en: Runic symbols cover the weapon.

lines.zh: 武器的寒光刺痛你的眼睛。
lines.en: The weapon's cold light stings your eyes.
Its weapon is ready for battle.

lines.zh: 寒光从武器上折射出来。
lines.en: Cold light refracts from the weapon.

lines.zh: 它转着手腕，让矛尖发光。
lines.en: It rolls its wrist, making the spear tip gleam.

lines.zh: 绿皮上的汗珠一颗颗亮起。
lines.en: Sweat beads shine on its green skin.

lines.zh: 它贴着石壁绕到你侧面。
lines.en: It hugs the wall and circles to your flank.

lines.zh: 矛杆轻敲地面，打着节拍。
lines.en: The spear butt taps the ground in rhythm.
It quiets its breath and waits for you to move.

lines.zh: 昏暗里只有矛尖是亮的。
lines.en: In the gloom only the spear tip shines.

lines.zh: 它把你逼向洞底的死角。
lines.en: It drives you into the dead end of the cave.

lines.zh: 那道寒光始终在你脖子上。
lines.en: That cold gleam never leaves your neck.
My axe grazes over your head!
My sword, your blood!
You're not worthy!
You can't avoid it!

lines.zh: 昏沉地下，我的斧头可不昏。
lines.en: My head's foggy. My axe is not.
Feel my rage!
You're not worthy!
Death is near!

lines.zh: 头还晕着，手已经挥出去。
lines.en: My head still spins, but my arm swings.
Despair now!

lines.zh: 矛尖直直捅向你的肋骨！
lines.en: The spear stabs straight at your ribs!
It ducks low and slams into your chest!

lines.zh: 绿手死死扯住你的盔甲！
lines.en: Green hands clamp onto your armor!
The spear shaft whips at your head!

lines.zh: 它边刺边用牙咬你的手！
lines.en: It thrusts and bites your hand at once!

lines.zh: 跳起来把矛扎向你的背！
lines.en: It leaps and drives the spear at your back!

lines.zh: 从暗处爬起来，先找武器。
lines.en: I rise from the dark and look for a weapon.
Hunter of shadows!
Night's vengeful spirit!
Guardian of the depths!
Seeking your soul!
The beginning of fear!
A revelation in darkness!
Whispers of death!
Decaying entity!
Devour the light!
Two green points of light glow in the stone cave.

lines.zh: 黑暗里传来矛尖刮石的声音。
lines.en: A spear tip scrapes stone somewhere in the dark.

lines.zh: 它从地精的巢穴里钻出来。
lines.en: It crawls out of a groglin burrow.

lines.zh: 盔甲的响动先到了，它随后。
lines.en: The armor's clatter arrives first; then it does.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处响起一声咕哝。
lines.en: A grumble sounds from deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 它踩着同伴的骨头走出来。
lines.en: It walks out over its kin's bones.

lines.zh: 阴影里立起一个矮小的绿影。
lines.en: A short green shape rises from the shadows.
Whispers seep out of the cracks in the wall.
My leather armor smells burnt.

lines.zh: 地面的撞击几乎让我失去意识。
lines.en: Impact almost knocked me unconscious.

lines.zh: 水中的窒息令我无法呼吸。
lines.en: Drowning makes it hard to breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击力差点把我撕裂。
lines.en: Explosion almost tore me apart.
Arrow pierced my body.

lines.zh: 魔法力量侵蚀我的身体。
lines.en: Magic corrupts my body.

lines.zh: 饥饿让我的意识开始模糊。
lines.en: Starvation clouds my mind.
Lightning strikes, immense pain.

lines.zh: 虚空的腐蚀从内部侵蚀我。
lines.en: Void corrosion eats away at me.
